transcript: Something I really like starting my Facebook video ads with a question that you know your prospects will say yes to. By getting them to say yes in their mind at the start of your video, it makes it much more likely they're going to watch the rest of the video. That makes it much more likely they're gonna hear about your offer. Convert. Take the action that you want to take. A good example would be something like are you struggling to get good results with your Facebook ads, or are you spending too much time cooking and cleaning? If you sell a Facebook ad service or a housekeeping service, those would be great options.
